mechanism.diagnostic_mode: matched absolute context, including models trained under wrong context
mechanism.map_summary_unit: pooled directional query rows across fit WSIs; risk/Token summaries equal WSI mean within patient
mechanism.selectivity_summary_unit: query mean within WSI, equal WSI mean within patient, equal mean over all eligible fit patients; separate pooled-query summaries are not the behavior gate
mechanism.selectivity_missing_scope: primary support excludes rows with <2 candidates by prelocked definition; all-row support, low-candidate and constant-score rates retain all base-valid queries; absent-query WSIs/patients omitted only from undefined averages and counts disclosed
mechanism.covariance_rank_scope: population centered feature covariance; nonlinear post-MLP covariance rank is not input Jacobian rank; mask-pattern variation retained
mechanism.summary16_energy_match_scope: actual fit-response energy ratio; isotropic nominal matching does not force this value to one
mechanism.RNA_anchor_beta_projection_scope: Euclidean coefficient geometry only; nominal all-genes-measured filter responses; not explained DSS information, a patient-specific bound, or a distilled target
mechanism.isolated_gradient_target: sum of eight matched patient risks; only new correction reads overridden C/R leaves; no raw target output
mechanism.isolated_gradient_no_correction_scope: unused leaves yield zero with unavailable flag; no claim of broken gradients in no-correction arms
